verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships AgentOS (CLI + hosted MCP server + skills/plugins) explicitly designed so AI agents like Claude Code/Cursor can execute natural-language instructions that translate into production actions (reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, multi-step workflows), and live probes confirm the MCP endpoint and CLI installer are real and functioning as documented. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports of actually issuing natural-language commands end-to-end and confirmation of reliability/accuracy in production use beyond vendor docs.
